translit:
Jit tit the mariyo | jem dhani vahono dhor ||
Sitapati bin Jivana | Jam padego rol ||55||

Date phadun khat pan | avar bhogvi chhutse ||
Jan Jivan jani kahun | pan akhar Jamra lutse ||56||

Harijan aye parona | uthi sove rand ||
Jam dvare Jivana | bohot hoegi bhand ||57||

|| Iti Shri Kalko Ang sampurna ||8||
translation:
55. He is beaten from this side and that, like a beast with no owner. Without Sitapati, O Jivana, Yama will make his rout.

56. "I will tear the bond up with my teeth" — yet another man must live his karma out before he is free. The servant Jivan says this knowingly: in the end Yama will plunder him.

57. The devotees of Hari come as guests, but the worthless woman gets up and goes back to sleep. At Yama's gate, O Jivana, there will be great disgrace.

Here the sacred Kalka Ang, the eighth, is complete.
